meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Transfer operation of a customer deployment with ownership, evidence and a tested support path. Use for handoff or an engineer rotation, not merely code delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把客户系统的运维交接做清楚:归属、证据、验证过的支持路径一次到位
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正要把一套线上系统交给别人接手,或接手别人的系统
copy.tagline_en: Transfer a customer system with ownership, evidence and a tested support path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handing a live system to someone else or taking one over

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把客户部署的交接整理成带归属、证据和已验证支持路径的记录，用于交接或工程师轮换，不只是交付代码。
howto.when: 当你要做客户部署交接，或工程师轮换时触发；动手前会先读任务上下文契约与方法说明。

say.text: 帮我给这个客户部署做交接记录，写明归属人和证据。
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约

say.text: 这次工程师轮换的交接，沿用 @fde 的上下文，别重头再问。
say.note: 复用已有的净化信息包

say.text: 把没跑过的检查项列出来，别当成已完成。
say.note: 保留未知项并如实报告

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a customer deployment handoff into a record with ownership, evidence and a tested support path. It serves handoffs or engineer rotations, not just code delivery.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you do a customer deployment handoff or an engineer rotation; it reads the task context contract and the method before acting.

say_en.text: Write the handoff record for this customer deployment, with owner and evidence.
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract first

say_en.text: Continue this engineer rotation from the @fde packet, don't restart setup.
List the checks that were never run, don't mark them done.
